'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Allen Gamble DS Knowledge And Defense (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Allen Gamble]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Dark)|Knowledge And Defense (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
